name: Loan Application Approval Workflow
description: End-to-end workflow for evaluating and approving/rejecting loan applications

stages.name: Input Validation
stages.description: Validates that the request is complete and well-formed

stages.name: Credit Check
stages.description: Fetches credit score from external bureau and evaluates against thresholds

stages.name: Risk Scoring
stages.description: Evaluates loan amount, debt-to-income ratio, and employment stability

stages.name: Final Decision
stages.description: All checks passed — application is approved

stages.name: Rejected
stages.description: Application has been rejected due to rule failure

stages.name: Manual Review
stages.description: Application requires human agent review — automated decision not possible
